pageTitle: Klacksy: The AI Assistant That Learns Your Operating Rules | Klacks

hero.titleHtml: Klacksy: The AI assistant that learns your operating rules.
hero.subtitle: No generic off-the-shelf AI. Control the tone, autonomy, and terminology of a scheduling assistant that follows your exact rules — rule-based, traceable, in your hands.
hero.screenshotAlt: Klacksy AI assistant in Klacks scheduling
hero.screenshotCaption: Screenshot shown in German — the app itself is also available in English.

items.title: Standard AI doesn't know your rules
items.text: Standard chatbots know nothing about your workplace agreements, qualification requirements, or industry-specific regulations — every answer is a shot in the dark.

items.title: Unclear scope of action
items.text: With many AI tools, it's unclear what the AI may change on its own and what it may not — a risk as soon as real schedules are involved.

items.title: Foreign language, foreign abbreviations
items.text: A standard AI doesn't understand your company's internal abbreviations and terminology — every request first has to be laboriously explained.

solutions.title: How Klacksy adapts to your operation
solutions.subtitle: Four dials that turn Klacksy into your own assistant.

items.title: Set your own autonomy level
items.text: Four adjustable levels let you decide, per user, how much Klacksy may do on its own — from pure suggestions to independent changes. Sensitive actions always require your confirmation.

items.title: Operating rules, just by saying them
items.text: You describe a company rule right in the chat — for example, “night shift surcharge 25% from 11pm” or “maximum 3 night shifts per week.” Klacksy asks targeted follow-up questions until all required details are complete and verified, shows a preview of the result, and saves it only after your explicit confirmation — always traceable in the rule register, and reversible.

items.title: Train your terminology
items.text: Klacksy learns your company's specific abbreviations and phrasing, so requests are understood correctly right away.

items.title: Adjust the personality
items.text: Under Settings you'll find the personality editor “Klacksy Personality”: there you set Klacksy's tone and character — to match your company culture.

example.title: A home care provider sets up Klacksy for its team
example.text: The autonomy level is set to “Propose”: Klacksy prepares route suggestions and automatically checks staff qualifications — the final decision always stays with the care manager. The night-shift surcharge rule was set up by chat, and Klacksy was trained on the abbreviations used in-house. The assistant already responds accordingly today — with no programming at all.

cta.title: See Klacksy in action
cta.text: Try the Playground to see how Klacksy applies autonomy levels, personality, and terminology — or install Klacks directly on your own infrastructure. Free, no registration required.
